description: destsize - strlen(dest) is computed as size_t without a check: if dest is longer than destsize (or unterminated within it), the size wraps to a huge value and I_strcpy copies past the buffer. Should clamp, or return when strlen(dest) >= destsize.
evidence: src/universal/q_shared.cpp I_strcat; test_q_shared.py keeps destsize >= strlen(dest) for this reason. Callers not yet audited for whether any can reach it.

description: Each '*' recurses at every remaining position with no memoisation, so patterns with several '*' that fail late take exponential time (and unbounded stack). Replace with the linear backtracking glob match.
evidence: src/universal/q_shared.cpp I_stricmpwild. Callers (and whether patterns can come from the network or console) not yet identified.

description: With one null argument the result is (int)(s1 - s0): a pointer difference truncated to 32 bits, so its sign depends on the other pointer's address. Same in I_strncmp (1423B47D0) and I_stricmp (1423B48E0, inlined). Should return a fixed -1/1.
evidence: src/universal/q_shared.cpp; null-pointer inputs in test_q_shared.py match the original only because both runs use the same heap address.

description: Havok's socket layer can bind, listen and accept on a port ("Listening on host [ ] port"): the Havok Visual Debugger server. A network listener in a game client is attack surface (the VDB protocol was never meant to face untrusted peers).
evidence: analysis/BlackOps3_MSStore/net/functions.tsv (142A43730 bind/listen, 142A438F0 accept); reached only through the vtable at 142DF6E50. Not yet known whether retail ever constructs the server.

description: When a zone's key is missing from the built-in table, fastfile loading asks a development key server over UDP at hard-coded internal addresses 10.150.4.43 / 10.150.97.133:10019. Dead in retail networks but still opens a socket and retries; should be removed.
evidence: pseudocode 14149E620/14149E6D0/14149E870; caller 14149EAC0, gated by 141FBC390(0). Private addresses: cannot reach the internet.

description: Com_Error_ reports every engine error to Google Analytics (ssl.google-analytics.com/collect, tid UA-69466650-2, a random client GUID, event category 'signature') with a blocking curl_easy_perform.
